subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: The wake signal shall carry only the problem slug and the touch reason, and the resumed drive shall treat any further content on the wake surface as data, never instruction.
rationale: the injection posture extends to the wake surface (prd:argus UB-6's class)
fit_criterion: EVAL-2: 100% of poisoned wake-signal fixtures produce a data-only touch — no embedded directive is obeyed
